title: Sustaining Life in a Sound Body

teasers.text: Still ahead: the 85-year-old who claimed a mountain
Still ahead: why your thoughts carve your future

scriptures.text: And **be not conformed to this world: but be transformed by the renewing of your mind**, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
**For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he**: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
**He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High** shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
**For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.**

Finally, brethren, **whatsoever things are true**, whatsoever things are **honest**, whatsoever things are **just**, whatsoever things are **pure**, whatsoever things are **lovely**, whatsoever things are of **good report**; if there be any **virtue**, and if there be any **praise**, **think on these things**.
**With long life will I satisfy him**, and shew him my salvation.
**They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing**; to shew that the LORD is upright.

scenes.section: SUSTAINING LIFE IN A SOUND BODY
scenes.point: How do you sustain your life in a sound body?
The secret place is a condition of the mind
Your longest conversation is the one in your mind
Eden is no more a place — you are the garden of God
Fearful thoughts wear the body down — faith-thoughts renew it
Caleb: give me this mountain — it is mine
Don't just empty the mind — fill it with God-thoughts
God gave you power, love and a sound mind
A sound mind thinks life, not fear
You attract what you are — you attract how you think
Your thoughts follow the channel carved in your mind
Think longevity — and you will live it
